archery_ranges_5 = {
	cost_gold = regular_building_cost_tier_5
	construction_time = construction_time_5_years
	district_level_requirement = 4
	levy = poor_building_levy_tier_5
	can_construct = {
	}
	can_construct_potential = {
	}
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
		OR = {
			culture = { has_innovation = innovation_advanced_bowmaking }
			culture = { has_cultural_era_or_later = culture_era_late_medieval }
		}
	}
	is_enabled = {
		is_county_capital = yes
	}
	character_modifier = {
	}
	county_modifier = {
		stationed_archers_damage_mult = normal_maa_damage_tier_5
		stationed_archers_pursuit_mult = normal_maa_pursuit_tier_5
		stationed_archers_screen_mult = normal_maa_screen_tier_5
	}
	county_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = formation_fighting_archery_ranges_bonuses
		stationed_archers_damage_mult = low_maa_damage_tier_5
		stationed_archers_toughness_mult = low_maa_toughness_tier_5
	}
	province_modifier = {
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_category_base_metals_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	market_rite_modifier = {
		parameter = leather_permitted
		trade_good_leather_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_base_metals
		amount = metal_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				stationed_archers_damage_mult = 0.02
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_leather
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		not_rite_parameter = leather_forbidden

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				stationed_archers_toughness_mult = 0.02
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_fabrics
		amount = basic_resource_need

		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		rite_parameter = leather_forbidden

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				stationed_archers_toughness_mult = 0.02
			}
		}
	}

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_military_context_modifier = yes
		ai_archer_modifier = yes
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_capital_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_regular_building_upgrade_modifier = { LEVEL = 5 }
	}

	next_building = eu5_interior_archery_ranges_5_discovery
}
